notes: Front Desk keeps the computer awake while it's open: a main computer that went to sleep dropped off for every support computer, and supports could start offering to take over.
Start Front Desk when this computer starts: a new Setup item, This computer.
On a Mac, Front Desk opens in its own window: it was landing as a tab in the Chrome already open.
One Mac app for Intel and Apple-chip Macs: the connect code for phones is drawn without Pillow, the one part that stopped a universal build.
A Mac app opened from the disk image says to move it to Applications first, instead of starting without its files (macOS runs an app opened from Downloads or a disk image from a hidden copy).
Linux: install-front-desk-linux.sh puts Front Desk in the applications menu; the kit carries the QR code library in a lib folder (Debian and MX Linux refuse a plain pip install); the start script…
Support computers keep checking in while the main computer can't be reached: asleep, restarting or off the Wi-Fi, a support used to refuse ("couldn't reach the main computer") and the scan was lost.
